# Test linkage: does the YELLOW dot position depend on the GREEN dot position?
# Visit all 9 green positions, record yellow dot each time.
def dots(f):
    a=f.ascii.split('\n')
    y=[(r,c) for r in range(64) for c in range(64) if a[r][c]=='Y']
    n=[(r,c) for r in range(64) for c in range(64) if a[r][c]=='N']
    return (y[0] if y else None, n[0] if n else None)
# green top-left target positions

# current green top-left

print("start green TL:", g)
# build move plan: from current (row,col) TL to target
def plan(cur,t):
    r,c=cur; tr,tc=t; mv=[]
    while r<tr: mv.append('UP'); r+=2
    while r>tr: mv.append('DOWN'); r-=2
    while c<tc: mv.append('RIGHT'); c+=2
    while c>tc: mv.append('LEFT'); c-=2
    return mv
obs={}
cur=g
for t in targets:
    mv=plan(cur,t)
    if mv: action(mv)
    y,n=dots(current_frame)
    obs[t]=(y,n)
    cur=n
for t in targets:
    print("greenTL",t,"-> yellow",obs[t][0],"green",obs[t][1])
